from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tools'))
from windows_unelevated import run_standard
from process_runner import run_process

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('stage', choices=['setup', 'nvidia-soak', 'intel-soak', 'intel-cases', 'native-timeout', 'ascii-smoke', 'loader-diagnostic'])
args = parser.parse_args()
record_path = ROOT / 'out/02d-final-work/relocation-linked.json'
proof = ROOT / 'out/graphics-package-linked-proof'
proof.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
digest = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if args.stage == 'setup':
    base = Path(os.environ['LOCALAPPDATA']) / 'Temp' / ('Shark 02d Linked 20261018 ' + chr(0x6e2c) + chr(0x8a66))
    assert not base.exists()
    assert base.resolve().parent == (Path(os.environ['LOCALAPPDATA']) / 'Temp').resolve()
    base.mkdir()
    package = base / 'package'
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'out/graphics-package/02d-final-linked', package)
    (base / 'working directory').mkdir()
    record = {'base': str(base), 'package': str(package), 'cwd': str(base / 'working directory'),
              'package_manifest_sha256': digest(package / 'package-manifest.json'),
              'scope': 'Relocation on the existing Windows development host, not a clean-machine claim'}
    record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
else:
    record = json.loads(record_path.read_text())
    base, package = Path(record['base']), Path(record['package'])

removed = []
for key in list(os.environ):
    if key.upper().startswith(('VS', 'VC', 'VULKAN', 'VK_', 'WINDOWSSDK', 'UCRT', 'UNIVERSALCRT', 'VSCMD', 'PYTHON')) or key.upper() in ('INCLUDE', 'LIB', 'LIBPATH', 'DEVENVDIR', 'EXTENSIONSDKDIR', 'FRAMEWORKDIR', 'FRAMEWORKDIR64', 'FRAMEWORKVERSION', 'FRAMEWORKVERSION64'):
        removed.append(key)
        del os.environ[key]
system = Path(os.environ['SystemRoot'])
os.environ['PATH'] = ';'.join(str(p) for p in [system / 'System32', system, system / 'System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0'])
powershell = system / 'System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe'
receipt = {'schema_version': 1, 'stage': args.stage, 'scope': record['scope'], 'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           'script_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)), 'relocation': record,
           'environment': {'PATH': os.environ['PATH'], 'removed_keys': sorted(removed)}, 'checks': []}

def run(name, mode, expected, *, selected=package, extra=(), standard=True, timeout=120):
    output = base / 'results' / name
    command = [str(powershell), '-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', str(selected / 'Run-GraphicsProbe.ps1'),
               '-Mode', mode, '-Output', str(output), *extra]
    if standard:
        result, security = run_standard(command, cwd=Path(record['cwd']), timeout=timeout)
    else:
        result, security = run_process(command, cwd=Path(record['cwd']), timeout=timeout), {'mode': 'current elevated development terminal'}
    summary = json.loads(result.stdout)
    item = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'security': security, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
            'expected_exit_code': expected, 'timed_out': result.timed_out, 'cleanup_errors': list(result.cleanup_errors),
            'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(), 'stderr': result.stderr,
            'summary': summary}
    item['status'] = 'PASS' if result.returncode == expected and not result.timed_out and not result.cleanup_errors and summary['exit_code'] == expected else 'FAIL'
    receipt['checks'].append(item)
    (proof / (name + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(item, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(name, item['status'], result.returncode, flush=True)
    if item['status'] != 'PASS':
        raise RuntimeError(name + ' failed; retained proof: ' + str(proof / (name+'.json')))
    return output

if args.stage == 'setup':
    run('relocated-describe', 'describe', 0)
    corrupt = base / 'corrupted shader package'
    shutil.copytree(package, corrupt)
    shader = corrupt / 'shaders/compute_cs.spv'
    data = bytearray(shader.read_bytes()); data[-1] ^= 1; shader.write_bytes(data)
    run('corrupted-shader-rejected', 'cases', 1, selected=corrupt, extra=('-Device','868088a7040000000002000000000000'))
    missing = base / 'missing DLL package'
    shutil.copytree(package, missing)
    (missing / 'bin/msvcp140.dll').unlink()
    run('missing-crt-rejected', 'cases', 1, selected=missing, extra=('-Device','868088a7040000000002000000000000'))
    run('elevated-validation-not-run', 'cases', 3, extra=('-Device','868088a7040000000002000000000000'), standard=False)
elif args.stage == 'nvidia-soak':
    run('relocated-nvidia-soak', 'cases', 0, extra=('-Device','863d6f59a51894ab8b4829aa9460c78d',
        '-LifecycleCycles','100','-DeviceCycles','20','-PresentSeconds','600','-TimeoutSeconds','1200'), timeout=1240)
elif args.stage == 'intel-soak':
    run('relocated-intel-soak', 'cases', 0, extra=('-Device','868088a7040000000002000000000000',
        '-LifecycleCycles','100','-DeviceCycles','20','-PresentSeconds','600','-TimeoutSeconds','1200'), timeout=1240)
elif args.stage == 'intel-cases':
    run('relocated-intel-cases', 'cases', 0, extra=('-Device','868088a7040000000002000000000000'), timeout=160)
elif args.stage == 'loader-diagnostic':
    os.environ['VK_LOADER_DEBUG'] = 'all'
    run('ascii-loader-diagnostic', 'smoke', 3, selected=base.parent / 'Shark-02d-linked-ascii-20261018', extra=('-Device','863d6f59a51894ab8b4829aa9460c78d'))
elif args.stage == 'ascii-smoke':
    ascii_package = base.parent / 'Shark-02d-linked-ascii-20261018'
    assert not ascii_package.exists()
    shutil.copytree(package, ascii_package)
    run('ascii-control-smoke', 'smoke', 0, selected=ascii_package, extra=('-Device','863d6f59a51894ab8b4829aa9460c78d'))
elif args.stage == 'native-timeout':
    run('relocated-native-timeout', 'cases', 124, extra=('-Device','863d6f59a51894ab8b4829aa9460c78d',
        '-PresentSeconds','600','-TimeoutSeconds','1'), timeout=45)
receipt['status'] = 'PASS'
receipt['finished_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
(proof / (args.stage + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
